ReportWorkspace.title: Reports
ReportWorkspace.ceoScope: See results across your organization. Choose a farm to narrow the report.
ReportWorkspace.managerScope: See results for your assigned farms. Record daily work in Today.
ReportWorkspace.chooseBatch: Choose a batch to see feed results.
ReportWorkspace.empty: No matching records in this report.
ReportWorkspace.loadFailed: Could not load this report. Check the filters and refresh.
ReportWorkspace.accessDenied: Reports are available to CEOs and assigned Farm Managers.
ReportWorkspace.sourceNote: Read-only results from the existing records. Missing values are not treated as zero.

notices.batchScope: Feed results cover the whole selected batch. FCR is not averaged across batches.
notices.fcrHelp: FCR means feed conversion ratio: kilograms of feed used for one kilogram of eggs or bird growth. Missing production weights or feed records can make it unavailable.
notices.estimated: Some results are estimates. Review the source records before relying on profit or feed comparisons.
notices.stockPeriod: Receipts and usage cover the selected Gregorian month. Stock remaining is the current balance, not a historical month-end balance. Different item units are not added together. Expenses here belong to this warehouse; farm costs are in Sales and finance.
notices.financeScope: Recorded expenses are separate from estimated sales profit. Overlapping close periods are not added together. Managers see assigned-farm costs only.

ReportWorkspace.organizationScope: No farm assigned to this cost
ReportWorkspace.analyticsMoved: Results and charts are now in Reports. This page keeps history and corrections.

TodayRollout.title: Today workspace
TodayRollout.description: Enable Today for Farm Managers in this organization. Managers will use one place to record daily work.
TodayRollout.rollbackHelp: Disabling Today restores the previous manager pages. Saved records and audit history are kept. This does not approve the production pilot.
TodayRollout.reasonHelp: Required: 4 to 2000 characters. Saved in the audit history.
TodayRollout.saved: Rollout saved. Managers will see the change when they refresh or sign in again.
TodayRollout.loadFailed: Could not load rollout status or history. Refresh and try again.
TodayRollout.saveFailed: Could not change rollout. Your reason is kept. Refresh status before trying again.

Calendar.invalid: Choose a valid date within the allowed range.

Notifications.title: Attention and updates
Notifications.description: Unfinished work stays visible until the system verifies it.

errors.attention: Work needing attention could not be refreshed

empty.attentionCopy: All assigned checks and actions are resolved or waiting for a new event.
empty.updatesCopy: New assignments, deadlines, and verified outcomes will appear here.

hero.title: Every warning has an owner and a verified finish.
hero.copy: Assign responsibility, acknowledge the work, record what was corrected, then let the originating system verify the result.

errors.load: Could not load the action desk.
errors.update: The action could not be updated.

empty.title: No actions match this view
empty.copy: Clear the filter or continue normal operations.

dialog.completeHelp: Confirm that you corrected the source record. The CEO will receive a notification, review the updated source, and run the final system check.
dialog.fixedPlaceholder: Briefly describe the stock, record, or value you corrected.
dialog.notePlaceholder: Describe what you will check and the immediate next step.
dialog.evidencePlaceholder: Optional receipt number, count sheet, or observation.
dialog.evidenceHelp: Your confirmation does not close the task. The CEO must verify that the originating check is clear.

NotificationSettings.loadError: Notification preferences could not be loaded.
NotificationSettings.saveError: Notification preferences could not be saved.
NotificationSettings.title: Choose what interrupts you.
NotificationSettings.copy: The action desk always keeps the full record. These settings control which updates appear in your bell and, when available, reach your email.
NotificationSettings.safety: Changing notifications never changes ownership, deadlines, escalation, or verification.
NotificationSettings.off: Do not show optional bell updates
NotificationSettings.mandatory: Tasks assigned directly by the CEO always appear. Other updates follow this setting.
NotificationSettings.emailCopy: Transactional notices for assigned work and escalation.

errors.request: The request could not be completed.

success.opening: Opening stock saved. The warehouse ledger is ready.
success.count: Shelf count submitted. Any difference is now in Record Checks.
success.receipt: Stock received and added to this warehouse.
success.expense: Expense recorded. Warehouse quantities were not changed.
success.action: Stock action recorded with an audit trail.

hero.title: Know what is on the shelf, what arrived, and what operations used.
hero.copy: Feed, Daily Records, treatments, and vaccinations post their own usage. This page starts the month, receives purchases, confirms shelf counts, and records costs.

noWarehouse.title: No active warehouse is assigned
noWarehouse.copy: The CEO must create and assign a warehouse before a Farm Manager can establish, receive, use, or count stock.

advanced.title: More stock actions
advanced.copy: Transfers, returns, controlled use, and approved corrections

ceo.title: Warehouse oversight and financial close
ceo.copy: Operational entry stays with assigned Farm Managers. Use Governance for assignments and Branch Reports for reviewed month-end financial closing.

opening.title: Enter everything currently on the shelf
opening.copy: Register the item and its opening quantity together. This can only be completed once; later purchases use Receive stock.

stock.title: Current stock and automatic usage
stock.copy: Usage is grouped by the workflow that created it. No manual re-entry is needed.
stock.empty: No stocked items are recorded in this warehouse.

count.title: Count every stocked item together
count.copy: The ledger balance is evidence, not an editable opening value. A difference creates a Record Check and never silently changes stock.
count.placeholder: Optional: witness, damaged stock, sealed bags, or recount notes

expense.warning: This records a cost and does not change warehouse stock.
expense.warningHelp: Use Receive stock when goods physically arrive.
expense.empty: No expenses confirmed for this warehouse this month.

Today.title: Today’s work
Today.question: What work must I finish today?
Today.intro: Choose a farm, house, and flock. Then complete today’s work in order.

guide.title: Finish the farm day in three simple steps
guide.step1Help: Select the farm, house, flock, and date you are recording.
guide.step2Title: Complete one card at a time
guide.step2Help: Save each card here. Today opens the next unfinished job for you.
guide.step3Help: Check what is missing, then finish the day while connected to the internet.

Today.featureDisabled: Today is not enabled for this farm yet
Today.featureDisabledHelp: Use the current Manager Dashboard while the simplified workflow is being prepared for your organization.
Today.wrongRole: Today is designed for assigned Farm Managers.
Today.loadFailed: Today’s work could not be loaded. Refresh and try again.
Today.noFarms: No active farm is assigned to you.
Today.noFarmsHelp: Ask the CEO to assign your account to a farm before recording today’s work.
Today.noActiveFlockHelp: You can still record stock, sales, expenses, and finish the farm day.

birdCheck.title: Check birds
birdCheck.help: See today's live bird count. Record deaths and culls in Health; the count updates automatically.
birdCheck.opening: Birds at the start of the day
birdCheck.closing: Birds at the end of the day
birdCheck.equation: Opening + moved in − deaths − culled − moved out − other removals
birdCheck.expectedClose: The closing count should be {count} birds.
birdCheck.enterCounts: Enter valid whole bird counts to calculate the closing count.
birdCheck.mismatch: The closing count does not match the bird movements above.
birdCheck.missingOpening: The opening count is missing. Review the source record before continuing.
birdCheck.healthEntry: Birds at the end = birds at the start − deaths − culls. Enter any deaths or culls in Record health and deaths.
birdCheck.legacyMovements: This record has older movements or a count that needs review. Use Daily Records for the exact correction.
birdCheck.offlineHelp: Keep this page open. Offline draft storage will be enabled in the next offline-work task; reconnect before saving.

embedded.completedSummary: Saved in the farm record. Open to review.
embedded.healthNoneSummary: Confirmed: no health problem or deaths today.
embedded.healthRecordedSummary: Health or mortality work was recorded.
embedded.suppliesNoneSummary: Confirmed: no routine supplies used today.
embedded.attentionSummary: Open this step and fix what needs attention.

examples.birds: Enter what physically changed in the flock; the expected closing count is calculated for you.
examples.feeding: For each feeding time, enter the feed actually used or explain why it was missed, then finish feeding for the day.
examples.eggsWater: Enter litres of water used. Layer and parent flocks also record good, broken, and dirty eggs.
examples.healthDeaths: Choose ‘none today’ or record the death, health issue, treatment, or scheduled vaccination.
examples.supplies: Tick the box and add only routine supplies such as vitamins, packaging, or equipment. Leave it unticked if nothing was used.
examples.stock: Use Receive stock for a delivery, or Count stock for the scheduled shelf count.
examples.sales: Record what was sold, the quantity, price, and amount already paid.
examples.expenses: Record a farm cost such as transport, utilities, labour, or maintenance.
examples.assignedFixes: Update the work here; open exact evidence only when you need to inspect the source record.
examples.review: Check every missing or unsynced job before closing the farm day.

embedded.readySummary: Open and enter this work here without leaving Today.
embedded.saved: Saved. Moving to the next unfinished step.
embedded.feedClosed: Feeding is complete and stock was updated once.
embedded.feedAlreadyClosed: Today’s feeding is closed and complete.
embedded.fedHelp: Tick this when feed was given. Enter the actual kilograms used, feed item, and warehouse.
embedded.missedHelp: Tick this when this feeding did not happen. Enter why it was missed; no feed stock will be removed.
embedded.notesOrMissedReason: Notes or reason feeding was missed
embedded.missedReasonRequired: Explain why this feeding session was missed.

healthModes.none: No health problem, deaths, or culls

embedded.healthChoicesHelp: Tick what happened today. You can tick more than one; save each section shown below.
embedded.lossSaved: Deaths, culls, and live bird count saved together.
embedded.startBirdCheckFirst: Start today's bird record in Check birds before recording deaths or culls.
embedded.vaccinationSaved: Vaccination completed and vaccine stock updated.
embedded.suppliesSaved: Supply use saved and stock updated.
embedded.chooseWarehouseToCount: Choose a warehouse to see the items that must be counted.
embedded.stockCountSaved: Stock count saved and differences recorded.
embedded.finishHelp: This final check uses the server records. The day will not close if required work is missing, rejected, conflicting, or waiting to sync.
embedded.alreadyFinished: This farm day is already finished and safely closed.
embedded.connectToFinish: Connect to the internet before finishing the day.
embedded.acknowledgedNote: I have seen this task and accepted responsibility.
embedded.startedNote: I started working on this task.
embedded.noAssignedFixes: You have no assigned fixes for this farm.

Errors.unauthorized: You do not have access to this work.
Errors.assignmentChanged: Your farm assignment changed. Connect and refresh before continuing.
Errors.staleRevision: This record changed after you opened it. Review the latest values and try again.
Errors.locked: This day is locked. Ask the CEO to approve this change.
Errors.insufficientStock: There is not enough stock in the selected warehouse.
Errors.validation: Check the highlighted information and try again.
Errors.offlineFinish: Connect to the internet before finishing the day.
